  • Method Details

    • allowedOrigins

      public CorsRegistration allowedOrigins(String... origins)
      Set the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser. Please, refer to CorsConfiguration.setAllowedOrigins(List) for format details and other considerations.

      默认情况下，允许所有源，但如果同时设置了`allowedOriginPatterns`，则以后者为准。

      See Also:
      • allowedOriginPatterns(String...)

    • allowedOriginPatterns

      public CorsRegistration allowedOriginPatterns(String... patterns)
      Alternative to allowedOrigins(String...) that supports more flexible patterns for specifying the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser. Please, refer to CorsConfiguration.setAllowedOriginPatterns(List) for format details and other considerations.

      默认情况下，此项未设置。

      Since:
      5.3

    • allowedMethods

      public CorsRegistration allowedMethods(String... methods)
      Set the HTTP methods to allow, for example, "GET", "POST", etc. The special value "*" allows all methods. By default, "simple" methods GET, HEAD, and POST are allowed.

      请参见CorsConfiguration.setAllowedMethods(List)获取详细信息。

    • allowedHeaders

      public CorsRegistration allowedHeaders(String... headers)
      Set the list of headers that a pre-flight request can list as allowed for use during an actual request. The special value "*" may be used to allow all headers.

      请参见CorsConfiguration.setAllowedHeaders(List)获取详细信息。

      默认情况下，允许所有标头。

    • exposedHeaders

      public CorsRegistration exposedHeaders(String... headers)
      Set the list of response headers that an actual response might have and can be exposed. The special value "*" allows all headers to be exposed.

      请参见CorsConfiguration.setExposedHeaders(List)以获取详细信息。

      默认情况下，此项未设置。

    • allowCredentials

      public CorsRegistration allowCredentials(boolean allowCredentials)
      Whether the browser should send credentials, such as cookies along with cross domain requests, to the annotated endpoint. The configured value is set on the Access-Control-Allow-Credentials response header of preflight requests.

      注意： 请注意，此选项会与配置的域建立高度信任关系，同时也会增加 Web 应用程序的攻击面，因为它会暴露敏感的用户特定信息（如 Cookie 和 CSRF 令牌）。

      默认情况下，此选项未设置，此时`Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` 响应头也未设置，因此不允许使用凭据。

    • allowPrivateNetwork

      public CorsRegistration allowPrivateNetwork(boolean allowPrivateNetwork)
      Whether private network access is supported.

      默认情况下，此选项未设置（即不支持私有网络访问）。

      Since:
      5.3.32
      See Also:
      • 私有网络访问规范

    • maxAge

      public CorsRegistration maxAge(long maxAge)
      Configure how long in seconds the response from a pre-flight request can be cached by clients.

      默认情况下，该值设置为 1800 秒（30 分钟）。
